summary_1line: Devotee Mallamma’s steadfast faith brings miracles and reconciliation, while the boy Gopala’s intense devotion wins a direct vision of Lord Siva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lord Mallesvara reveals his radiant true form before the kneeling Mallamma in the forest shrine after she threatens to break her head against the idol.
Cow dung touched by Hema Reddi inside Mallamma’s humble cattle shed miraculously transforms into shining gold.
The child Gopala opens his eyes to behold Lord Mallikarjuna and goddess Bhramaramba standing alive before the temple idol.
